description: This file defines the RealtimeService class, responsible for managing WebSocket connections for real-time attendance updates in the frontend of an attendance tracking application.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Provides real-time WebSocket connection management for attendance updates, including connecting, disconnecting, and streaming data.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection and starts listening for attendance update events.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the stream controller and disposes of the WebSocket client.
